column1: # Pages of the documentation site that moved, so that an address published before the move keeps
# working. One line per page: the old path and the new path, separated by a tab, both relative to
# the site root (docs/security-patches/ on privacysafe.app). gen-site.py --theme privacysafe-app
# writes a page at each old path that forwards to the new one (meta refresh, noindex, canonical
# address of the new page). 26.11.25 moved every tool page into its category folder.
